create_PyProcess: create a PyProcess instance to run Python code in a separate process and avoid the GIL
build_TFProxy_operations: build TensorFlow operations via _TFProxy that delegate method calls to a worker process
run_PyProcessHook: run PyProcessHook as a MonitoredSession hook to start and stop worker processes automatically
test_proxy_compute_method: test the proxy's compute method by calling it with tensor specs defined in _tensor_specs
review_PyProcess_close: review the PyProcess close method to properly terminate worker processes and clean up resources
